source_text: Filiae Hierusalem in Libro III eruditionem recipiunt de egressu animae: non in hieme passionum foras ire, sed post tranquillitatem Verbo oboedire. Qui oculos columbae non habent, dramatis litteram inanem putant; qui habent, hiemem et ver, petram et vulpes in anima agnoscunt.
pass_a_gloss: Daughters of-Jerusalem in Book III learning receive about going-out of-soul: not in winter of-passions outdoors to-go, but after calm to-Word to-obey. Who eyes of-dove not have, of-drama letter empty think; who have, winter and spring, rock and foxes in soul recognize.
pass_b_english: In Book III the daughters of Jerusalem receive teaching about the soul’s going out: not to go outdoors in the winter of passions, but after calm to obey the Word. Those without dove-eyes think the drama’s letter empty; those who have them recognize winter and spring, rock and foxes in the soul.
